approval.purpose: Pending action, command, path, and preview.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Drop and approval state transitions (120–150 ms).

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Remove motion and press scale; EmberHorizon remains static.

components.name: Send
components.description: Amber 28px circular action with ink symbol; disabled state uses surface and secondary.

components.name: Allow
components.description: Amber approval action with ink label; remember scope comes from runtime.

components.name: Composer
components.description: 16px surface well with attachment, screen-read, mic, and explicit send controls.

components.name: Approval Well
components.description: 12px monospace action preview replacing the composer.

components.name: Working Light
components.description: EmberHorizon lower-edge sweep: 10px blur at 0.7 opacity plus 1.5px crisp stroke.

narrative.overview: Tibo is a small black island cut into the menu bar. It grows sideways into a short work surface for asking, attaching, watching an agent act, and approving one consequential action. Warm paper, scarce amber, and tonal wells keep it focused.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Amber marks send, allow, focus, drop, and attachment presence—not decoration, status copy, or history.

rules.name: The Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember belongs only to the working light and app-icon/onboarding bezel; it is never a state color.

rules.name: The Black Island Rule
rules.body: The island stays hardware black; do not replace it with material or adaptive glass.

dos: Do use human wording before monospace machine detail.
donts: Don't color status text or history amber.
Don't use ember as a status color.
